About Us

Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support. While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.
